_comment: ripr mutation seam baseline for fluxion-core (Issue #1254). Generated by ripr-preflight.yml with workflow_dispatch update_baseline=true. Used by the gate job to detect regression in weakly_gripped seam count.

gate_threshold._comment: Workflow fails CI if weakly_gripped exceeds this. Override via repo variable RIPR_WEAK_SEAM_THRESHOLD. Current baseline is 494; threshold of 100 means the gate is informational (warns) until tests are added to bring the count down.

update_instructions: To refresh this baseline: run the workflow with workflow_dispatch -> update_baseline=true, or locally: cd fluxion-core && ripr check --root . --mode draft --format repo-exposure-json | python3 scripts/ripr-extract-baseline.py > .ripr/gate-baseline.json
